messages:
Ana: FYI we have a new partnership intro with FortressLock (HSM + secrets mgr). They want SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and our Vault plugin shown in a joint marketplace listing. Can partnerships/product/eng confirm timeline? :megaphone:
Sam: Security note: need to confirm FIPS-140 level, attestation PDF, and whether FortressLock supports KMIP or only provider-specific key-wrap APIs. Also surface any PCI/PASSP compliance claims.
Priya: Eng-infra volunteer to build the plugin + SCIM adapter. ETA: 2 sprints for a POC, 4 sprints for GA-quality (tests, docs, CI). Need SAML metadata + SCIM sample payloads from FortressLock.
Marco: I'll draft marketplace copy and a short partner quickstart. We should include a terraform example for Private customers and a console walkthrough gif.
Devon: Legal: ask FortressLock for logo usage rules, PR embargo date, and channel-reselling clause. We require 5 business days review for press copy.
Priya: Quick SCIM mapping proposal (minimal):
```
user.id -> externalId
user.userName -> emails[0].value
user.name.givenName -> firstName
user.name.familyName -> lastName
groups -> groupIds
```
Will add custom attribute mapping if FortressLock exposes role/org.
Sam: For demo mode, recommend showing customer-managed CMKs in FortressLock HSM for Private, and a platform-wrapped key flow for Hosted. Also add tests for key rotation and key access latency.
Ana: Marketing asks for a 1-pager with three sections: supported modes (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), security/compliance summary, and partner quote. Marco to collect screenshots and a GIF.
Marco: Need a FortressLock demo tenant + SAML metadata URL to capture flows. @FortressLock-bot please provide a test tenant or demo credentials link.
FortressLock-bot: (automated) Request received for SAML metadata and demo tenant. Support rep will reply within 24 hours with a staging tenant.
Devon: I'll circulate an MOU template with channel/resell language; drop redlines in #partnerships-legal. Also confirm embargo date once FortressLock proposes one.
Priya: Rollout plan suggestion: partner alpha (1-2 pilot customers) -> internal SOC review -> public GA. Tracking KPIs: provisioning success rate, SCIM delta latency, key-op latency, and error rate.
Sam: Ops item: add HSM attestation link to technical appendix rather than front-page. Public marketing: high-level statement only (e.g., "FIPS-certified HSM support").
Ana: Action list:
- Priya: SCIM + Vault plugin POC (owner)
- Marco: marketplace copy + assets (owner)
- Sam: security checklist + attestation request (owner)
- Devon: MOU template + embargo handling (owner)
I'll create a tracking spreadsheet and schedule a sync 2026-04-27 10:00 PT. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
